questions.question: The synthesis sitting of b761 under (R371)(5): the agenda is banked whole (data/b761_sitting_agenda.txt :236), 16 items, one for each FINDINGS heading of b745 to b760 that is no corrigendum, each read from REGISTRY, the cluster table of SPIRAL_MAP and the keystone’s text at PLACE-papers HEAD. As the maps read them: 5 SYNTHESISED (items 1 b745, 2 b746 by names the Epstein document v0.2 carries outside any relay path; items 9 b753, 11 b755, 15 b759 by relay paths alone, banks and tools, which canon XXIV sends out of the paper at its re-cut); 7 CLUSTERED, each an input of the Epstein document’s re-cut (items 3 b747, 4 b748, 6 b750, 7 b751, 13 b757, 14 b758, 16 b760); 4 BANKED with no seat (items 5 b749, 8 b752, 10 b754, 12 b756). No keystone is written at this sitting. The navigator recommends that items 8, 9, 10 (b752, b753, b754), reads of the record’s own documents, take no keystone and stand BANKED; with it 4 read SYNTHESISED, 7 an input of a re-cut and 5 banked (data/b761_sitting_agenda.txt :236). The agenda also lists the open orders by their triggers (data/b761_sitting_agenda.txt :136): 10 met, each to be taken up at b762 or the act its ruling names; 36 waiting on your word; 4 with no trigger written, carried by name to the next ruling; 29 written and not met. Pass the agenda whole, pass it with the navigator’s recommendation, or strike items by number (name them in your note): a struck item stands as the maps read it, with your word beside it.

options.label: With the recommendation (Recommended)
options.description: The agenda passed with the navigator’s recommendation: items 8, 9, 10 stand BANKED, so 4 read SYNTHESISED, 7 an input of the Epstein document’s re-cut and 5 banked with no seat; the inputs bank written for that keystone.

options.label: Passed whole
options.description: Every item stands as the agenda reads it: 5 SYNTHESISED, 7 an input of the Epstein document’s re-cut, 4 banked with no seat; the inputs bank written for that keystone.

options.label: Strike by number
options.description: Items struck by number, named in your note: each struck item stands as the maps read it with your word beside it, and the rest pass.

options.label: Sitting not held
options.description: The amendment of (5) struck: the sitting is not held and the agenda stays banked; the act’s sentence reads that the agenda is banked, not put, your word on its form awaited.
